paper_metadata.title: An overview of the oxidation of Ni-based superalloys for turbine disc applications: surface condition, applied load and mechanical performance

evidence.quote: Ni-based superalloys have been optimised, compositionally and microstructurally, to operate in the highly stressed conditions occurring in the hot sections of gas turbine engines.
